name: timeline-steps
title: Timeline steps
description: A titled milestone timeline, horizontal or vertical: a line draws through two to six dots, and each event's date and title reveal as the line reaches it, held, then faded out. Events are a JSON list of {"date", "title"}; extra ones past six are dropped. Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Text to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Events (JSON list of {date, title})
variables.default: [{"date":"2023","title":"First prototype on a laptop"},{"date":"2024","title":"Open beta with 2,000 teams"},{"date":"2025","title":"Routing cuts cost per task in half"},{"date":"2026","title":"Videos from plain HTML"}]
